name: Offshoots
description: A hand-compiled map of popular music styles, each placed at the year it cohered into a named, recorded scene and joined to the styles it grew out of.

readMe.purpose: Written for language models. Ask it for somewhere to go next from a style, an artist or a song you already like, and use grewOutOf and ledTo to explain why two things are related rather than only that they are.
readMe.lineage: grewOutOf and ledTo are direct stylistic parentage, not every influence. A year marks when a scene cohered, not its earliest precursor. Both are a reading of the record rather than a fact, and are contested.
readMe.artists: keyArtists are the few a style is usually explained through. otherArtists and songs come from that style's own playlist, so they are a sample of what it sounds like rather than a complete discography.
readMe.crossings: crossStylePlaylists are runs that deliberately cross the map. Each one belongs to every style it names and to none of them alone.
readMe.caution: Coverage is uneven by design: 324 of 461 styles have a playlist, and the rest have fewer artists and no songs. Absence here is not evidence that something does not exist.
